exposure: Peripartum infection at the first cesarean delivery
cohort: Women with a prior cesarean delivery at a single academic medical center from March 2014 to October 2020
finding: Peripartum infection at the first cesarean delivery may be an independent risk factor for uterine rupture at a subsequent delivery.
mod_finding: Peripartum infection at the first cesarean delivery may be an independent risk factor for uterine rupture at a subsequent delivery.
